data.gender_notes: Surajraj is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Surajraj is a compound name derived from two Sanskrit words: 'Suraj' meaning sun and 'Raj' meaning king. The name Surajraj signifies the ruler of the sun and represents the power and authority of the sun. The name Surajraj carries the meaning “King of Sun” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit. Parents who choose Surajraj usually hope their child will grow to embody king of sun and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Surajraj is a powerful and auspicious name that represents the divine power of the sun and the inner radiance and strength of an individual. It is a name that inspires courage, confidence, and leadership.
data.etymology: Surajraj belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “King of Sun.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Surajraj total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.

historical_references.reference: Surajraj was a title given to the Maratha king Shahuji II (r. 1749-1754). The term Surajraj means 'King of the Sun'.

The title Surajraj was also used by the Maratha king Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj (r. 1630-1680). He is known as 'Father of the Maratha Nation' and the title Surajraj was used to signify his status as the king of kings and the source of all light and power for his people.
